src.bungie: Dodge to perform an acrobatic leap. Upon landing, make yourself and nearby allies radiant.
src.clarity:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs a front flip in your movement input's direction and slams down the ground with a Solar Knife.
Upon landing after using Acrobat's Dodge:
• Grants you and allies within ? meters Radiant for 10 seconds (15 with Ember of Solace)
• Deals up to 40 [20] damage to targets in a ? meter radius
src.compendium:
Performs an acrobatic leap, that, upon landing, grants the user and their allies within 10 meters Radiant for 10+5 seconds.
Enemies within 6.5 meters are dealt up to 40 [20] Solar Damage upon landing.

src.bungie: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with both moderate speed and directional control.
Vault into the air and unleash a volley of Solar-charged knives that explode and scorch targets.
src.compendium:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90?% [49%]
Releases two volleys of 7 homing knives each, totalling 14 knives.
Knock 'Em Down adds an additional 3 knives to each fan, totalling 20 knives.
Knives embed themselves on impact, dealing 99 [not much?] damage and detonate after 0.5 seconds.
Knife explosions deal up to an additional 560 [generally dead?] damage each and inflict x?+? Scorch over 4.25m.
Deals a total of 8,512 [death] (12160 [deathx1.43] with Knock'Em Down) damage with all knife hits+explosions

src.bungie:
Summon a flaming maul and crush targets with the force of an earthquake.

[Light Attack]  : Spin the maul in a circle around you, damaging nearby targets.

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam the maul to the ground and create a cyclone of flames that seeks targets, dealing damage and scorching them.
src.compendium:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [53%]
Base Duration: 25 seconds, or 4% Super Drain per Second
Sol Invictus creates a Sunspot on cast if grounded, and reduces Passive Drain by 40%, increasing duration to 42 seconds, or 2.4% Super Drain per second.
Light Attack | Drains 4% Super Energy.
Spinning attack that deals 111 [?] damage 4 times. Has a 0.67 second delay between light attacks.
Continously scoring hits grants 40% Increased Attack Speed until no longer scoring hits.
Scoring 10 hits with Light Attacks spawns a Cyclone. Can only spawn 1 Cyclone per Super Activation.
Heavy Attack | Drains 8% Super Energy
Slams down, releasing a homing projectile which explodes on impact, dealing 276 [?] damage and creating a Cyclone.
Cyclones deal 24 [16] damage every 0.2 seconds, and apply x3+2 Scorch every 0.56 seconds for 4 seconds.

src.bungie: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with a strong initial boost of speed.
Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with a strong initial burst of momentum.
Send out a spiral of three explosive Solar energy blasts, scorching targets with each hit.
src.compendium:
Sends out a spiral of 3 homing Solar blasts.
Solar blasts each deal up to 150 [35] damage and inflict x10+5 Scorch in a ? meter radius.
Can deal up to 450 [105] damage and inflict x30+15 Scorch by scoring hits with all 3 Solar blasts.

src.bungie:
While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to launch a wave of [Solar] Solar energy forward, damaging and scorching targets in front of you as you leap into the air.

While airborne, activate your charged melee again to slam to the ground and create a second larger wave of damaging [Solar] Solar energy. If the wave hits a scorched target, they ignite.
src.clarity:
Using your Charged Melee Ability while sliding launches a Solar Wave that travels 20 meters and applies 40 Scorch (60 Scorch with Ember of Ashes) to all enemies hit. Consumes 50% Melee Energy on use, and grants 25% damage resistance against non-Melee Combatant damage during the animation.
After launching the Solar Wave, active your Melee Ability again to consume the remaining 50% and slam down, sending a second wave that travels the same distance, deals damage, and shatters Stasis Crystals. If this wave hits any Scorched enemies, they instantly Ignite.
Firing your weapon during the slide disables this ability.
src.compendium:
While sliding:
[Melee Ability] launches a wave of Solar Energy 20 meters forward, dealing 40 [30] damage and inflicting x40+20 Scorch. 
Only consumes 50% Melee Ability Energy if the slam is not activated. Unable to use during slide if user shoots.
While airborne from the Consecration Melee Ability:
[Melee Ability] slams the ground, creating a second, wider wave that travels 20 meters forward, shatters crystals, and deals 486 [120] damage to Non-Scorched Enemies.
Hits against Scorched Enemies with the second wave deal 472.5 [50] damage and trigger an ignition.
Grants 25% Damage Resist against Non-Melee Damage while in the Melee Animation.

src.bungie:
Activate your class ability to fire up to three scorching shots at combatants you've marked. Aim at targets to mark them.

Landing all three shots cures you.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
src.clarity:
Sets your Base Class Ability cooldown to that of Marksman's Dodge.
With full Class Abililty energy, enemies you look at within 27 meters become visually marked. Mark up to 3 enemies.
Casting your Class Ability with at least one mark active fires three ~150-180 RPM Scorching Golden Gun rounds equally divided across all marked enemies. Lower frame rates can slow the RPM, though animation duration remains the same.
Each shot deals 354 [21] damage and applies 20 Scorch (30 with Ember of Ashes). Landing all 3 shots grants Cure x1.
Can be activated while in the air, and triggers the effects of your equipped dodge when activated.
Benefits from Radiant, which grants the shots 20% [0%] increased damage. Pairing Crackshot with Acrobat's Dodge always applies the damage bonus.
Crackshot can further scale up to 65% increased damage at 200 Class Stat.
src.compendium:
Hovering the reticle near enemies within 27 meters applies a ◇mark until they leave Line of Sight.
Replaces Class Ability with Crackshot Dodge and overrides Class Ability Cooldown to Marksman's Dodge.
Triggers the effects of the equipped Class Ability on usage.
Crackshot Dodge can be used midair, triggering a burst of speed.
No interaction with Celestial Nighthawk :(
On Crackshot Dodge:
Fires up to 3 Scorching Shots at an average of 150RPM over 1.2 seconds. RPM varies based on FPS. Lower framerate = Slower RPM at the same animation duration.
Scorching Shots deal 354 [21] Damage and inflict x20+10 Scorch. 
Landing all 3 Scorching Shots grants Cure x1.
Radiant grants 20% Increased Crackshot Damage against Combatants.
Damage scales with Class Stat above 100, up to 65% [10%] at 200 Stat. Acrobat Dodge's Radiant applies before Crackshot is fired.

src.bungie:
Fashion Solar Light into blades and smite your foes from the sky.

Your Daybreak projectiles scorch targets on impact.
src.compendium:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [51%]
Base Duration: 24 seconds, or 4.167% Super Drain per Second.
Light Attack | Drains 6.5% Super Energy to launch a Daybreak Projectile.
Daybreak Projectile deal 426 [?] Impact Damage, exploding on impact, dealing up to 598 [?] Splash Damage, down to 0% damage, inflicting x50+0 Scorch over 5 meters, and launching a streak of flames behind them.
Flame streaks travel ahead, scaling from ~4m to 9m if the Daybreak Projectile traveled at least 12 meters, dealing up to 292 [?] Damage on hit.
Allows the usage of an enhanced Icarus Dash without cooldown that drains 4.2% Super Energy per usage.
Phoenix Dive is enhanced, dealing up to 642 [220?] Damage, down to a minimum of 292 [?] Damage, and inflicting x60+30 Scorch over a 6 meter radius. Deals 45% damage at max falloff.
Phoenix Dive damage is enhanced by Super Damage Increases.

src.bungie: You apply more scorch stacks to targets.
src.clarity:
Increases the number of Scorch Stacks you apply to targets by 50% in MOST cases.
Always rounds up: 3 🠚 4.5 🠚 5
Specific increases from Ember of Ashes for Scorch sources can be found in their descriptions.

src.bungie: Your Solar Super projectiles have stronger target acquisition.
src.clarity:
Grants Solar Super projectiles stronger tracking.
Only affects Blade Barrage, Daybreak, and Song of Flame projectiles.

src.bungie: Applying restoration, cure, or radiant to allies grants increased grenade, melee, and class ability regeneration for a short duration.
src.clarity:
Applying certain buffs to allies grants 300% Additional Base Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Regeneration Rate for 7 [3.5?] seconds.
Activation Triggers:
• Granting the Cure, Radiant, or Restoration Solar subclass buffs to allies
• Healing (from most sources), or reviving allies
Will NOT trigger Ember of Benevolence:
Empowering Rifts, Mods, Crest of Alpha Lupi's Healing Pulse, Mothkeeper's Wraps Overshield Moth, Non-Solar Support Frame Auto Rifles

src.bungie: Defeating targets with Solar ignitions grants grenade energy.
src.clarity:
Ignition Kills grant Grenade Energy based on the Enemy Rank of the killed targets:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 8%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 12.25%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 16.5%
• Players: 20.75%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 25%
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

src.bungie: Your Solar ignitions spread scorch to affected targets.
src.clarity:
Ignitions apply 40 Scorch Stacks (60 with Ember of Ashes) to enemies damaged by the explosion.
Does not apply to the Ignited enemy.

src.bungie: Final blows with a Solar Super causes targets to ignite and creates a Firesprite.
src.clarity:
Targets killed by Solar Supers Ignite and spawn a Firesprite at their location.
Note: Well of Radiance makes all of the caster's Weapon Damage count as Super Ability Damage so Solar Weapons Kills will also count as Solar Super Kills.

src.bungie: Solar weapon or ability final blows extend the duration of restoration and radiant effects applied to you.
src.clarity:
Solar Kills extend the duration of Restoration and Radiant effects up to the maximum of 15 seconds.
Scoring a Solar Kill while Restoration's or Radiant's timer is above 15 seconds will lower it back down to 15 seconds.
Seconds added based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 1.5s
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 2.25s
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites, Enemy Players: 3s
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 6s

src.bungie: Your Solar ignitions have increased area of effect.
src.clarity: Ignitions have a 25% increased blast radius (8﻿🠚﻿10 meters).

src.bungie:
When you revive an ally, you and other nearby allies gain restoration.

Picking up a Firesprite grants restoration.
src.clarity:
Firesprite pickups grant Restoration x1 for 2 seconds (3 with Ember of Solace). Extends Restoration's duration by the same amount if it's already active.
Collecting a Firesprite while Restoration's timer is above 15 seconds will lower it back down to 15 seconds.
Reviving allies grants you and allies within ? meters Restoration x1 for 5 seconds (7.5 with Ember of Solace).

src.bungie: Solar grenade final blows cure you.
src.clarity: Grenade Kills grant Cure x1.

src.bungie: Defeating scorched targets grants melee energy and creates a Firesprite.
src.clarity:
Killing Scorched enemies spawns a Firesprite and grants Melee Ability Energy based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 8%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 15%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 17.5%
• Players: 20%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 25%
Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

src.bungie: Your class ability recharges faster when you scorch targets.
src.clarity:
Grants 400% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate for 3 seconds upon applying Scorch to enemies that are not currently Scorched.
Will not activate if the enemy dies from the hit that would have applied Scorch.

src.bungie: Radiant and restoration effects applied to you have increased duration.
src.clarity:
Restoration and Radiant effects applied to you last 50% longer.
Specific increases from Ember of Solace for Restoration and Radiant sources can be found in their descriptions.

src.bungie:
Solar weapon final blows grant you and your allies increased health for a short duration. Stacks 3 times.

While Ember of Tempering is active, your weapons have increased airborne effectiveness, and your Solar weapon final blows create a Firesprite.
src.clarity:
Solar Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Ember of Tempering for 8 seconds to you and allies within 15 meters.
Ember of Tempering grants the following benefits:
• 20|40|60 Health stat at 1|2|3 Stacks
• 20 Airborne Effectiveness
• Solar Weapon Kills spawn a Firesprite

src.bungie: Powered melee attacks against combatants make you and nearby allies radiant.
src.clarity:
Elemental Melee Hits make you and allies within 8 meters Radiant for 8 seconds (12 with Ember of Solace).
Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.

src.bungie: Rapidly defeating multiple targets with Solar ignitions generates an Orb of Power.
src.clarity:
Killing 2 enemies within ? seconds of each with Ignitions creates an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy.
10 second cooldown between activations.

src.bungie:
Conjure a well of power that increases weapon damage and ability energy regeneration for those inside it.

Defeating combatants while standing in the Rift grants additional ammo generation.
src.clarity:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.
Grants the following benefits to you and allies within the rift:
• 20% [15%] Increased Damage (Empowering Buff)
• 260% [104%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate
• 230% [92%] Additional Base Class Regeneration Rate
• Kills generate 15% Increased Ammo Meter Progress
src.compendium:
Conjures an Empowering Rift beneath the caster for 15 seconds. 
Rift grants 20% [15%] increased damage, 260% [104%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee, and 230% [92%] Additional Base Class Regeneration Rate in a 5 meter radius.
Kills while in the Rift grant 1.15x Ammo Generation Multiplier. Ammo Generation Multiplier is additive to Ammo Finder Multipliers.
Grants 20% Damage Resist and allows movement at a speed of ?m/s while in the Rift Placement animation.

src.bungie: A grenade that unleashes bolts of damaging Solar Light at nearby targets and slightly scorches them.
src.compendium:
Heavy Trajectory | Scan
Scans up to 4 enemies in Line of Sight within 8.5 metres upon impact, firing a bolt of Solar Light towards scanned enemies after a 1 second delay.
Solar Light Bolts deal 337 [65] damage and inflict x20+10 Scorch.

src.bungie: An explosive grenade that attaches to targets, damaging and moderately scorching them on detonation.
src.compendium:
Light Trajectory | Slightly Homing | Sticky
Attaches to enemies or surfaces, exploding after a brief delay.
Explosion deals up to 738 [130] damage and inflict x40+20 Scorch over 6 meters on detonation.

src.bungie: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.
src.clarity:
Only usable while on the ground.
Performs a deft tumble in your movement input's direction.
Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.
Grants 1% [0.35%] Fixed Melee Ability Energy per 1 point in the Melee Stat, up to 100% [35%] at 100 Melee Stat.
Melee Energy is doubled if performed within 15 meters of an enemy, allowing for a maximum refund of 200% [70%] energy.
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
src.compendium:
Performs a deft tumble that grants 1% [0.35%] Melee Ability Energy per Melee Stat, up to 100% [35%] Melee Ability Energy at 100 Melee Stat.
Dodging within 15 meters of an enemy doubles the Ability Energy gained. No Chunk or Stat Scalar.
Removes Combatant Projectile Tracking, as well as Aim Assist against Guardians during the Dodge Animation.

src.bungie:
Summon a rapid-fire flaming pistol that scorches and disintegrates targets with Solar Light.

Final blows with this weapon refund a Golden Gun round and extend your super duration.

Benefits from being radiant.

Summon a precision flaming pistol that scorches and disintegrates targets with Solar Light.

Your Golden Gun deals massively increased precision damage, overpenetrates targets, and creates Orbs of Power on precision hits.

Benefits from being radiant.

Defeat targets to charge up an improvised Solar explosive.

[Grenade]  : Throw a Solar explosive that can be shot in mid-air to cause an ignition.
src.clarity:
Kills charge up an Improvised Explosive (three Tripmines duct-taped together).
Kills grant charges based on the method used:
• Weapons: 1 [2] charge
• Ignition and Scorch: 3 [4] charges
• Abilities: 4 charges
• Super: 6 charges
At 6 charges, replaces your Grenade Ability with a thrown explosive that travels with reduced velocity. Explosive causes an Ignition when detonated, and incurs a 6 second cooldown upon throw.
Shooting the explosive increases its damage by 50% [5%], ignition radius by ?%, and releases 9 homing submunitions from its center. Sticking the explosive directly onto an enemy and then shooting it adds an additional damage instance equal to 67% [?] of the aboved buffed detonation.
If not shot, the explosive detonates on its own after 3 seconds.
Gunpowder Gamble counts both as an Ignition and a Grenade Ability. It triggers, and is buffed by, both grenade and ignition-specific effects.
src.compendium:
Kills charge up an Improvised Explosive. Readies at 6 Charges.
Weapon = 1 [2] | Ignition & Scorch = 3 [4] | Abilities = 4 | Super = 6
Replaces Grenade with an Ignition-on-a-Stick that causes an ignition that deals 50% increased damage upon being shot or after 3 seconds.
Shooting the dynamite increases its damage by 50% [5%], its radius by ?% to ? meters, and releases 9 homing submunitions, with each dealing up to 80 [?] Damage.
Incurs a 6 second cooldown after activating. Kills while on cooldown don't give charges.

src.bungie:
Summon a flaming hammer and wreak destruction down upon your enemies.

[Light Attack]  : Throw your hammer at foes.

Upon impact, your hammers shatter into explosive molten shards.
src.compendium:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [51%]
Base Duration: 21 seconds, or 4.75% Super Drain per Second
Light Attack | Drains 12% Super Energy
Throws a Hammer that explodes on impact, dealing up to 445 [?] damage. Has a 1.5 seconds delay between Hammer Throws.
Impacts release 4 shrapnel, dealing up to 396 [?] damage each.
Hammers visually flares up after being airborne for 0.7 seconds, increasing Shrapnel amount to 5.
Phoenix Cradle Interaction:
Reduces Passive Drain by 20%, increasing duration to 26.25 seconds, or 3.81% Super Drain per second.
Light Attacks drain 7.5% Super Energy and the delay between Hammer Throws is reduced to 1 second.
Loreley Splendor Helm Interaction:
Reduces Passive Drain by 40%, increasing duration to 35 seconds, or 3.63% Super Drain per second.
Light Attacks drain 8.2% Super Energy and the delay between Hammer Throws is reduced to 1 second.
Both Exotic Interactions assume 100% Sol Invictus buff uptime, which is not always possible.

src.bungie:
After sprinting for a short time, use this melee ability to swing a blazing hammer that scorches your target and deals damage in a cone behind them.

If your target is defeated by Hammer Strike, they ignite.
src.compendium:
Shared with other Shoulder Charge Abilities:
Requires sprinting for 1.25 seconds. Drains 15% Melee Ability Energy if no enemy is hit. Unable to use during slide if user shoots.
Guardians directly hit by Shoulder Charge have their Melee Lunge disabled for 0.5 seconds
Lunges forward 6.8 meters, automatically targeting enemies in range.
Hitting an enemy deals 878 [90] impact damage and inflicts x40+20 Scorch, as well as dealing 586 [60] radial damage to enemies up to 7 meters behind the struck target.
Scoring a Hammer Strike kill on the directly struck enemy triggers an ignition.

src.bungie: A grenade that cures allies on impact and creates an Orb of benevolent Solar Light, granting restoration to allies when picked up.
src.compendium:
Very Light Trajectory | Strong Ally Homing
Applies Cure x1 to the user and allies within 7.5 metres of impact, and creates a Restoration Orb that lasts 7.5 seconds.
Restoration Orb applies Restoration x1 for 4+2 seconds upon being picked up. Orb has a 7.5 meter pickup radius, and 100 HP.

src.bungie: Conjure a well of power that continuously heals those inside it.
src.clarity:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.
Heals you and allies in the Rift for 40 [35] HP per second.
If at full health, the Rift grants 3 HP of Overshield per second, up to a 15 HP Overshield.
Standing in a friendly Healing Rift makes the game count you as having an active Overshield at all times.
src.compendium:
Conjures a Healing Rift beneath the caster that continuously restores 40 [35] HP per second in a 5 meter radius for 15 seconds.
While at Full Health | Healing Rift generates 3 Overshield HP per second, up to 15 Overshield HP. Having Void Overshield prevents this from happening.
Overshield can stack with other overshields, such as Turnabout's OS and Class Stat OS. Overshield layers are determined by "First In, First Out".
Healing Rifts cause the users to count as having Overshields for the purpose of perk interactions.
Grants 20% Damage Resist and allows movement at a speed of ?m/s while in the Rift Placement animation.

src.bungie:
You can fire weapons, melee, and throw grenades while gliding.

[Grenade]  : Hold to consume your grenade, gaining Heat Rises and releasing a burst of healing energy that cures nearby allies. The strength of the burst is increased when a Healing Grenade is consumed.

Final blows while airborne increase the duration of Heat Rises and grant melee energy.
src.clarity:
Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness. Allows you to use your weapons and abilities while gliding.
Kills while Airborne grant Melee Energy based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors: 20%
• Elites: 25%
• Minibosses: 35%
• Bosses and Players: 50%
Hold [Grenade] to consume it, activating 'Heat Rises' for 15 seconds, and grant Healing to you and allies within a 9 meter radius based on what was consumed.
Consuming a Healing Grenade grants Cure x3. If Touch of Flame is equipped, this also grants Restoration x1 for 4 seconds.
Consuming a Song of Flame Wisp grants Cure x3 and Restoration x2 for 4 seconds.
Restoration effects are extended to 6 seconds with Ember of Solace. All other grenades grant Cure x2.
Heat Rises grants 50 Airborne Effectiveness and effectively infinite Glide flight time, along with improved base movement capabilities of your equipped Glide. Enemy combatants are less accurate while Heat Rises is active.
Scoring kills while Airborne extends Heat Rises, up to a maximum of 30 seconds based off Combatant Rank:
• Minors and Players: 5 seconds
• Elites and Minibosses: 10 seconds
• Bosses: 15 Seconds
src.compendium:
Passively grants +20 Airborne Effectiveness, and allows Weapon and Ability Usage while gliding. 
Kills while Airborne grant Melee Energy.
Tier 1 Combatant = 20% | T2 = 25% | T3 = 35% | T4 = 50% | Guardians = 50%
Hold [Grenade] to consume a Grenade Ability Charge, granting Heat Rises and releasing a burst of Cure x2 that affects the user and their allies within 9 meters.
Consuming a Healing Grenade increases Cure to x3. Consuming a Touch of Flame Healing Grenade additionally grants Restoration x1 for 4+2 seconds.
Consuming a Song of Flame' Wisp releases a burst of Cure x3 and grants Restoration x2 for 4+2 seconds to the user and their allies within 9 meters.
Heat Rises
Grants +50 Airborne Effectiveness, and a modified Glide that changes depending on the selected Movement Ability for 15 seconds.
Combatants are less accurate at targeting the wearer while active.
Modified Glide has -99% Glide Upkeep and Activation cost, extending maximum glide duration by 100 times, and marks the user's location on radar to Guardians within 25 meters.
Balanced Glide: Strong Directional and Initial Burst | Burst Glide: Strong Directional Control | Strafe Glide: Strong Initial Burst.
Scoring additional Airborne Kills while Heat Rises is active extends the buff duration, up to 30 seconds.
Tier 1 Combatant = +5 seconds | T2 & T3 = +10 seconds | T4 = +15 seconds | Guardians = +5 seconds
Consuming a Grenade always overwrites the duration to 15 seconds, even if it was previously higher.

src.bungie:
Activate your class ability to summon a [Solar] Solar mortar that lobs flaming projectiles at distant targets. Targets damaged by the mortar are scorched.

Hellion damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Grenade stat.
src.clarity:
Casting your Class Ability grants 'Hellion' for 20 seconds.
Hellion fires Scorching projectiles every 1.35 seconds up to a distance of 32 meters, and inflict 30 Scorch per hit in a 4 meter radius (40 Scorch with Ember of Ashes).
Hellion projectiles count as a Grenade Ability and are buffed by, and trigger, grenade-specific effects. However, Scorch and Ignitions sourced by Hellion itself do not scale.
src.compendium:
On Class Ability Usage:
Grants Hellion for 20 seconds.
Hellion:
Lobs scorching Solar projectiles every 1.35 seconds towards enemies up to 32 meters away.
Solar projectiles deal up to 217 [38] Solar Grenade Ability Damage and inflict x30+10 Scorch per hit in a 4 meter radius.
Can trigger Grenade Ability interactions. Hellion-inflicted Solar Effects are not scaled by Grenade Damage.

src.bungie: While airborne, jump a second time to reach greater heights.
Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air to greater heights.

[Air Dodge]  : Dodge quickly while airborne.

While Heat Rises is active, you have an additional dodge.

While airborne, rapidly defeating targets with your Super or weapons cures you.
src.clarity:
While Airborne, pressing [Air Move] performs a horizonal dash that propels you 8 meters towards the input direction before entering a 4 second cooldown.
While Heat Rises or Song of Flame is active, gain an additional charge of Icarus Dash before entering a 5 second cooldown (currently only works in Song of Flame while using Incinerator Snap). Both charges are refilled per cooldown period.
Icarus Dash can be used infinitely during Daybreak at the cost of 4.2% super energy per use.
While Airborne, Weapon or Super Kills within 5 seconds of each grants Cure x1. Activation Progress is based on Combatant Rank:
• Minor: 34%
• Elite: 67%
• Bosses: 100%
• Players: 67%
src.compendium:
Horizontal dash that travels 8 meters. Distance is increased by 25% while in Daybreak.
Incurs a 4 second cooldown after usage.
While Heat Rises is active, or during the Song of Flame Super Ability while the Incinerator Snap Melee Ability is equipped:
 Gains an additional charge, and recharges both charges simultaneously, but increases cooldown to 5 seconds.
Does not grant 2 charges while in Song of Flame if the Celestial Fire Melee Ability is equipped. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
Upon reaching 100% Counter Progress through Weapon or Super Kills while Airborne within 5 seconds of each:
 Rank-And-File = 34% | Elites = 67% | Bosses = 100% | Guardians = 67%.
Grants Cure x1.

src.bungie: A grenade that explodes in a fiery burst and heavily scorches nearby targets.
src.compendium:
Medium Trajectory
Explodes after its speed is sufficiently reduced. Has a brief delay before it can explode.
Explosion deals up to 814 [130] damage and inflicts x60+30 Scorch over 8 meters on detonation.
Damage is increased by 31.5% to 1202 [173] damage if the enemy is within 1 meter of the grenade.

src.bungie: Snap your fingers to create a fan of burning sparks that explode and scorch targets.
src.compendium:
Creates a fan of 5 burning sparks.
Sparks explode after ? meters, each dealing up to 90 [27?] damage and apply x20+10 [x10+5] Scorch over a ? meter radius.
Can deal up to 450 [135?] damage and apply up to x100+50 [x50+25] Scorch by scoring hits with all 5 burning sparks

src.bungie: Throw a fan of flaming knives that scorch targets on hit.
src.compendium:
